correctness.rationale: For q any prime power, d>=2, A=F_q[X1,...,Xd]/m^3, set V=m/m^2 of dimension d, Z=m^2=Sym^2 V of dimension D=d(d+1)/2. Each F_q-linear unital subalgebra B=F_q1+W corresponds bijectively to U=proj_V W, T=W∩Z and a graph map phi:U->Z/T, with multiplication closure iff Sym^2 U⊆T (basis products independent also in characteristic 2). For s=dim U, e_s=s(s+1)/2, r=dim T, counting U,T,phi yields exactly [d s]_q [D-e_s r-e_s]_q q^{s(D-r)} z^{1+s+r}. For fixed q, s=0 count H_q(D); s=1 count [d1]_q(H_q(D)-H_q(D-1)); using Gaussian estimates and exponent s(d-s)+(D-s(s-1)/2)^2/4 excludes all s>=2 uniformly, so P(dim U=1)=1-(1+o(1))/[d1]_q=1-(q-1+o(1))q^-d. Independently exhausted all 374 subspaces of five-dimensional nilpotent ideal over F2 for d=2, yielding 50 closed, with dimension strata (1,7,19,19,3,1); formula gives q=3 profile (1,13,49,49,4,1). The last numerical profile is formula evaluation, not a full independent q=3 exhaustive claim.
